description: Build nextjs-lms-saas starter - Courses, memberships, and video with Next.js, Clerk, Neon/Prisma, Mux, Stripe, and UploadThing. Must follow Web SaaS blueprint. Create on branch feat/nextjs-lms-saas from current HEAD.
steps: Create and checkout branch feat/nextjs-lms-saas from current HEAD (feat/astro-beginner-static-site)

Create nextjs-lms-saas/ directory with exact-pinned Next.js 15 App Router scaffold (package.json with pnpm 10.x packageManager field, exact versions for next, react, react-dom, typescript, @clerk/nextjs, @prisma/client, prisma, @mux/mux-node, stripe, uploadthing, @uploadthing/react, tailwindcss, vitest, fast-check, eslint, eslint-config-next, @types/node, @types/react, @types/react-dom)
Add starter.json matching catalog entry (id:5, folder:nextjs-lms-saas, family:Web SaaS, etc.)
Create domain/entities.ts with Course, Lesson, Enrollment, Progress, Subscription, ProcessedEvent interfaces
Create domain/policies.ts with deny-by-default authorization: creator can manage own courses/lessons, learner can access enrolled courses, membership entitlement gates enrollment

Create lib/server/config.ts with typed ConfigSpec for CLERK_SECRET_KEY, DATABASE_URL, MUX_TOKEN_ID, MUX_TOKEN_SECRET, MUX_WEBHOOK_SECRET, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, UPLOADTHING_SECRET, NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
Create lib/server/errors.ts (sanitized errors including upload validation errors)
Create prisma/schema.prisma with Course, Lesson (with videoAssetId, videoPlaybackId, videoStatus), Enrollment, Progress, Subscription, ProcessedEvent models
Create prisma/migrations/ with initial migration SQL
Create lib/server/auth.ts - Clerk adapter for identity extraction
Create lib/server/billing.ts - Stripe BillingPort (createSubscription, verifyWebhook, handleSubscriptionEvent) and lib/server/billing-fake.ts with subscription state machine
Create lib/server/video.ts - Mux VideoPort (createAsset, getAssetStatus, deleteAsset) and lib/server/video-fake.ts with deterministic fake
Create lib/server/upload.ts - UploadThing UploadPort (validateUpload with type/size checks) and lib/server/upload-fake.ts
Create lib/server/database.ts - Prisma repositories for all entities with progress tracking
Create lib/server/providers.ts - provider selection based on placeholder detection
Create middleware.ts using @clerk/nextjs for route protection
Create app/page.tsx - public course catalog entry page
Create app/auth/ - Clerk sign-in/sign-up pages
Create app/dashboard/ - protected dashboard with creator view (upload video, manage courses/lessons) and learner view (browse, enroll, track progress)
Create app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts - Stripe webhook for subscription events with idempotent processing
Create app/api/webhooks/mux/route.ts - Mux webhook for video asset status updates
Create app/api/uploadthing/route.ts - UploadThing file router with type/size validation
Create tests/unit/domain/policies.test.ts - creator/learner authorization tests
Create tests/unit/server/billing.test.ts - Stripe fake adapter tests (subscription lifecycle)
Create tests/unit/server/video.test.ts - Mux fake adapter tests
Create tests/unit/server/upload.test.ts - UploadThing fake with type/size validation tests
Create tests/integration/auth.test.ts - unauthenticated/unauthorized denial, role-based (creator vs learner)
Create tests/integration/enrollment.test.ts - enrollment flow: subscribe, enroll, progress tracking
Create tests/property/auth-consistency.test.ts - Property 4
Create tests/property/webhook-authenticity.test.ts - Property 5 (Stripe subscription events)
Create tests/smoke/build.test.ts - build verification
Create .env.example with classified sections
Create README.md documenting LMS flow, creator/learner roles, video pipeline, upload validation, schema, tests, deployment
Add vitest.config.ts, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, postcss.config.mjs, next.config.ts, tailwind config
Run pnpm install to generate pnpm-lock.yaml
Verify: pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm build all pass
Git commit all files on feat/nextjs-lms-saas branch
acceptance_criteria: nextjs-lms-saas/ directory exists at repo root with all Web SaaS blueprint files
starter.json matches catalog entry id:5 exactly
pnpm run test passes (all tests including upload validation and entitlement)
Upload validation enforces type and size constraints before storage
Subscription state machine persists entitlement, renewal, cancellation
Fake adapters activate with placeholder env values
Property tests use fast-check with at least 100 runs
Video state tracking reflects Mux asset lifecycle
verification: cd nextjs-lms-saas && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
